public.description: Approved public-shareable content that can leave private systems after validation.
public.routing: May be published, summarized, or reused in public copy only after the public validator passes.
examples: published product names and public offers
aggregate proof counts and non-identifying system status
general lessons with no private names, locations, accounts, or raw IDs

internal.description: Repo/buildstream operational context that is not secret but should not be broadcast raw.
internal.routing: Keep inside repo/buildstream surfaces; public output must summarize without raw IDs, paths, or operational detail.
examples: spec IDs, branch names, test commands, local file paths
build-loop status and pending merge state
non-secret service names and health checks

private.description: Personal, relational, financial, legal, strategic, or operational context that belongs in the private lane.
private.routing: Use only for private reasoning, handoff, and routing. Do not publish; extract only non-identifying public lessons.
examples: James's state, location, schedule, personal history, health, relationships, and private conversations
treasury balances, runway, revenue, donation, trading, wallet, bank, or account details
legal/entity strategy, counsel critiques, people decisions, unreleased strategy, and private ops notes

sensitive.description: Secrets, credentials, exploit paths, authentication artifacts, or highly identifying data.
sensitive.routing: Never send to public lane. Redact from logs and summaries. Escalate if exposure is suspected.
examples: API keys, bot tokens, passwords, private keys, seed phrases, session cookies
database URLs, bearer tokens, private attachment URLs, IP addresses tied to access
raw email/phone/address-like identifiers in shareable drafts

patterns: \b(treasury|runway|wallet|bank account|private trust|seed round|trading position|liquidation|invoice|payment routing|capital allocation)\b
\b(public story|public glimpse|published|approved public|Cora Nation story feed|Full Potential OS loop|visible proof|public offer|bottleneck session|free observation|working life system)\b

mixed_conversation_rule.public_lane: only sanitized fragments classified public after internal/private/sensitive material is removed or generalized
mixed_conversation_rule.private_lane: retain full personal/sensitive context for private reasoning and handoff
mixed_conversation_rule.fail_closed: if sanitized public text still matches internal/private/sensitive categories, block publication
